extDescription.message: Sends your Ultimate Team club from the Web App to the FC-Tracker app on your own computer.

enterCode.message: Enter the code shown in the FC-Tracker app:

badgeNoApp.message: FC-Tracker: the app is not running or not connected

badgeNotPaired.message: FC-Tracker: not connected – click the extension icon

badgeWaiting.message: FC-Tracker: waiting for the Web App …

badgeError.message: FC-Tracker: the sync stopped ($ERROR$) – reload the Web App to try again.

bgNoResponse.message: The extension background is not responding – reload the extension

badgeAborted.message: FC-Tracker: you entered Ultimate Team – sync stopped, closing the Web App

badgeSaved.message: FC-Tracker: saved ✓ – the app picks it up the next time it runs

badgeAppClosed.message: FC-Tracker: the app is closed – your sync is saved. Open the app for the best sync

badgeSignIn.message: FC-Tracker – action needed: sign in to the Web App – the sync then starts by itself.

badgeNotReady.message: FC-Tracker – action needed: the Web App did not load your club. Check you are signed in, then reload this page.

updateInstalling.message: Update found – installing, the extension restarts in a moment.

updateRollingOut.message: The Chrome Web Store hasn't delivered it yet – it installs by itself, usually within a day.

upToDateChecked.message: No update – you have the newest version.

updateThrottled.message: Chrome allows the next check in a few minutes – try again then.

updateFailed.message: The check didn't work – try again in a moment.

updateManual.message: Installed from the .zip: download the new one, replace the folder, then press Reload in chrome://extensions.

badgeWebSynced.message: FC-Tracker: club synced ✓ – back to FC-Tracker Web

openFailed.message: FC-Tracker didn't open – is it installed on this PC? Get it at fc-tracker.com/download.
